content.content:
**Goal:** I'm using Taskly, a small to-do list web app, as a busy parent. The first task should be to water my fern, Bartholomew Quince. After that I should keep the list going for the session: add errands one at a time, check off finished ones, rename tasks when plans change, delete ones that no longer matter, and try the filters. At the end I report what worked and what my fern is called.

**What I've done and how it went:**
- **First attempt to add the fern task:** I clicked the "What needs doing?" field, typed "Water Bartholomew Quince," and clicked Add. The list then showed "Buy milk," which I hadn't added, and the fern text wasn't there. I don't know where my typed text went.
- **Second attempt:** I typed the same text and pressed Enter. This checked off "Buy milk" and changed "Pick up dry cleaning Friday" to "Pick up dry cleaning." The fern task still wasn't there.
- **Trying to undo:** I clicked the checkbox to uncheck "Buy milk." The click opened an edit box on "Pick up dry cleaning" instead. I then clicked a filter by mistake. Later the edit box closed and "Pick up dry cleaning Friday" had its original name back.
- **Later screens:** Tasks kept appearing, disappearing, being renamed, and being checked or unchecked, and I didn't do most of it. Examples: "Dentist appointment Thursday" was checked off and then vanished; "Call the plumber" appeared and was later renamed "Call the plumber about kitchen sink"; "Renew library book" was renamed "Renew library book by Friday"; "Buy milk" disappeared; "Pick up dry cleaning Friday" was checked, unchecked, checked again, and then gone; a long task "Pick up the birthday card for Sam and make sure to get the good wrapping paper from the shop downtown before the weekend" appeared and then vanished.
- **Reload:** I reloaded the page once. It showed "Pick up dry cleaning Friday," "Call the plumber," and "Renew library book." Changes kept coming after that.
- **Latest screen:** The Active filter is selected, showing only "Call the plumber about kitchen sink," unchecked, with "1 left."

**What surprised or confused me:**
- Text I typed into the input never showed up as a task.
- The filter buttons changed the view when I wasn't clicking them.
- Tasks changed while I was idle, which suggests someone or something else is editing the same list.
- I can't tell which of my own clicks caused which changes, so I can't fully trust the list.
- Earlier I wrote that checking off and renaming "worked." I wasn't able to confirm my own changes stuck, so that claim was too strong.

**Still to do / find out:**
- Confirm with the user that nobody else is editing this list. Don't make further changes until they do.
- Get the fern's name directly from the user. I can't confirm "Bartholomew Quince" from the app, so I shouldn't report it as verified.
- Try the fern task again on a clean list, and check that it appears before doing anything else.
- If the list is stable, continue with the errands, checking off, renaming, deleting, and the filters, and confirm each change after reloading.
- Write the final report: what worked, what didn't, and the fern's name as given by the user.
